import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.lang.reflect.Array;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
	
	static int mod = 998244353;
	static int g = 3;
	
	static long qpow(long a, long n) {
		long x = 1;
		a %= mod;
		while(n > 0) {
			if((n & 1) == 1) x = x * a % mod;
			a = a * a % mod; n >>= 1;
		}
		return x;
	}
	
	static void rader(long[] y, int len) {
		for(int i = 1, j = len / 2; i < len - 1; i++) {
			if(i < j) { long tmp = y[i]; y[i] = y[j]; y[j] = tmp; }
			int k = len / 2;
			while(j >= k) { j -= k; k /= 2; }
			if(j < k) j += k;
		}
	}
	
	static void NTT(long[] y, int len, int on) {
		rader(y, len);
		for(int h = 2; h <= len; h <<= 1) {
			long wn = qpow(g, (mod-1)/h);
			if(on == -1) wn = qpow(wn, mod-2);
			for(int j = 0; j < len; j += h) {
				long w = 1;
				for(int k = j; k < j + h / 2; k++) {
					long u = y[k];
					long t = w * y[k + h / 2] % mod;
					y[k] = (u + t) % mod;
					y[k+h/2] = (u - t + mod) % mod;
					w = w * wn % mod;
				}
			}
		}
		if(on == -1) {
			long t = qpow(len, mod - 2);
			for(int i = 0; i < len; i++)
				y[i] = y[i] * t % mod;
		}
	}
	
	public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
		FastScanner in = new FastScanner(System.in);
		PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
		
		int n = in.nextInt(), m = in.nextInt();
		int len = 1, nn = n / 2;
		while(len < (9 * nn + 1)) len <<= 1;
		long[] a = new long[len];
		long[] b = new long[len];
		
		a[0] = 1;
		for(int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
			int x = in.nextInt();
			b[x] = 1;
		}
		
		NTT(a, len, 1);
		NTT(b, len, 1);
		
		for(int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
			if(a[i] != 0 && b[i] != 0) {
				a[i] = a[i] * qpow(b[i], nn) % mod;
			} else a[i] = 0;
		}
		
		NTT(a, len, -1);
		
		long ans = 0;
		for(int i = 0; i < len; i++)
			ans = (ans + a[i] * a[i]) % mod;
		
		out.println((ans + mod) % mod);
		
		out.close();
    }
	
	static class FastScanner {
		private StringTokenizer st;
		private BufferedReader br;
		private PrintWriter pw;

		public FastScanner(InputStream stream) {
			br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream));
		}

		public String next() {
			while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
				try {
					st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
				} catch (IOException e) {
					throw new RuntimeException(e);
				}
			}
			return st.nextToken();
		}

		public int nextInt() {
			return Integer.parseInt(next());
		}
		
		public long nextLong() {
	        return Long.parseLong(next());
	    }

		public double nextDouble() {
	        return Double.parseDouble(next());
	    }

	}
}

import math

class FastScanner:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self.st = None
        self.br = open(stream, 'r')

    def next(self):
        while self.st == None or not self.st.hasMoreTokens():
            try:
                self.st = self.br.readline().split()
            except:
                raise Exception('Error reading from file')
        return self.st.pop(0)

    def nextInt(self):
        return int(self.next())

    def nextLong(self):
        return int(self.next())

    def nextDouble(self):
        return float(self.next())

mod = 998244353
g = 3

def qpow(a, n):
    x = 1
    a %= mod
    while n > 0:
        if n & 1:
            x = (x * a) % mod
        a = (a * a) % mod
        n >>= 1
    return x

def rader(y, len):
    for i in range(1, len - 1):
        if i < len // 2:
            y[i], y[len // 2] = y[len // 2], y[i]
        k = len // 2
        while len // 2 < k:
            k //= 2
        if len // 2 < k:
            len // 2 += k
        if i < len // 2:
            y[i], y[len // 2] = y[len // 2], y[i]

def NTT(y, len, on):
    rader(y, len)
    h = 2
    while h <= len:
        wn = pow(g, (mod - 1) // h, mod)
        if on == -1:
            wn = pow(wn, mod - 2, mod)
        for j in range(0, len, h):
            w = 1
            for k in range(j, j + h // 2):
                u = y[k]
                t = (w * y[k + h // 2]) % mod
                y[k] = (u + t) % mod
                y[k + h // 2] = (u - t + mod) % mod
                w = (w * wn) % mod
        h <<= 1
    if on == -1:
        t = pow(len, mod - 2, mod)
        for i in range(len):
            y[i] = (y[i] * t) % mod

def main():
    in_ = FastScanner('input.txt')
    out = open('output.txt', 'w')
    n = in_.nextInt()
    m = in_.nextInt()
    len_ = 1
    nn = n // 2
    while len_ < (9 * nn + 1):
        len_ <<= 1
    a = [0] * len_
    b = [0] * len_
    a[0] = 1
    for i in range(m):
        x = in_.nextInt()
        b[x] = 1
    NTT(a, len_, 1)
    NTT(b, len_, 1)
    for i in range(len_):
        if a[i] != 0 and b[i] != 0:
            a[i] = (a[i] * pow(b[i], nn, mod)) % mod
        else:
            a[i] = 0
    NTT(a, len_, -1)
    ans = 0
    for i in range(len_):
        ans = (ans + (a[i] * a[i]) % mod) % mod
    out.write(str((ans + mod) % mod) + '\n')
    out.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
